'''Dyrele''' is an [[Aiel]] from the [[Moshaine]] [[Shaido]].

== Appearance ==
She has green eyes.

== History ==
She was the wife of [[Maeric]] and was a [[Roofmistress]].

== Activities ==
Dyrele and Maeric, with part of their sept are dispersed through a [[Gateway]] near the Plains of [[Maredo]]. They run into three of [[Rand al'Thor|Rand al'Thor's]] forces and she was probably made ''[[gai'shain]]''.
